fullText.simplified:
第37章、男孩（下）

    男人笑了笑，继续说：“听到我说要杀了他，他害怕了，说不走了。我很高兴，他终于听话了。一个月后，有一天是我的生日，我请他去大饭店吃了晚饭，我们喝了很多酒，他还陪我吃了生日蛋糕。那天晚上我很高兴，以前我都是一个人过生日，那天有了他陪我，我们玩到很晚才回家。我喝了太多酒，很快就睡着了。一点多的时候，我听到一些声音，然后看到他在我的房间里，好像在找什么东西。我马上就醒了，大声问他：‘你找什么？’他没有回答，我把灯打开，看到他手里拿着很多钱。我马上明白了，他在找我的钱，他想拿了我的钱跑掉！我生气极了，大声说：‘我对你这么好，你还拿我的钱！’我拿起身边的椅子就去打他。我的力气很大，他很害怕，一边哭一边让我不要打。我听不下去，力气越来越大。
    打了很久，后来椅子打坏了，我扔了椅子，坐在地上，我还在生气。他躺在地上，没有说话，也不哭了。我失望极了，一点儿也不想看他。我坐了半个小时，他还是一点儿声音也没有。我觉得有些奇怪，就爬过去看他，发现他的身体很冷。我这才知道，他已经死了，他被我打死了。
    我害怕极了，不知道怎么办，不敢打电话给医院，也不敢打电话给警察局。我坐在他身边，哭了半个小时，后来我把他抱到了船上。那时候是三点钟，大家都在睡觉，没有人发现我们。我开着船，往大海的远方去。三个小时后，天亮了，船离海边已经很远了，我最后看了看他，然后把他推下了船，海水把他送到了远方。
    回来后，我打扫了房间，和以前一样工作。没有人发现他不见了，只有大饭店的人问过一次，说和我一起工作的年轻人去哪儿了，我回答说他回家了，后来就没有人问了。他本来就没有朋友，也从来不和家人联系，他就像个没家的人，死了也没人知道。
    第二年，我不出海打鱼了，还把海边的房子卖了。我在公园旁边买了一个新房子，换了一种新生活。这件事情已经过去十五年了，我从来没有和人说过，现在说给你们听，是因为我快死了，我已经不害怕了。”
fullText.traditional:
第37章、男孩（下）

    男人笑了笑，繼續說：“聽到我說要殺了他，他害怕了，說不走了。我很高興，他終於聽話了。一個月後，有一天是我的生日，我請他去大飯店吃了晚飯，我們喝了很多酒，他還陪我吃了生日蛋糕。那天晚上我很高興，以前我都是一個人過生日，那天有了他陪我，我們玩到很晚才回家。我喝了太多酒，很快就睡著了。一點多的時候，我聽到一些聲音，然後看到他在我的房間裡，好像在找什麼東西。我馬上就醒了，大聲問他：‘你找什麼？’他沒有回答，我把燈打開，看到他手裡拿著很多錢。我馬上明白了，他在找我的錢，他想拿了我的錢跑掉！我生氣極了，大聲說：‘我對你這麼好，你還拿我的錢！’我拿起身邊的椅子就去打他。我的力氣很大，他很害怕，一邊哭一邊讓我不要打。我聽不下去，力氣越來越大。
    打了很久，後來椅子打壞了，我扔了椅子，坐在地上，我還在生氣。他躺在地上，沒有說話，也不哭了。我失望極了，一點兒也不想看他。我坐了半個小時，他還是一點兒聲音也沒有。我覺得有些奇怪，就爬過去看他，發現他的身體很冷。我這才知道，他已經死了，他被我打死了。
    我害怕極了，不知道怎麼辦，不敢打電話給醫院，也不敢打電話給警察局。我坐在他身邊，哭了半個小時，後來我把他抱到了船上。那時候是三點鐘，大家都在睡覺，沒有人發現我們。我開著船，往大海的遠方去。三個小時後，天亮了，船離海邊已經很遠了，我最後看了看他，然後把他推下了船，海水把他送到了遠方。
    回來後，我打掃了房間，和以前一樣工作。沒有人發現他不見了，只有大飯店的人問過一次，說和我一起工作的年輕人去哪兒了，我回答說他回家了，後來就沒有人問了。他本來就沒有朋友，也從來不和家人聯繫，他就像個沒家的人，死了也沒人知道。
    第二年，我不出海打魚了，還把海邊的房子賣了。我在公園旁邊買了一個新房子，換了一種新生活。這件事情已經過去十五年了，我從來沒有和人說過，現在說給你們聽，是因為我快死了，我已經不害怕了。”

sentences.english: That night I was very happy. Previously I had always spent my birthday alone.

sentences.simplified: 那天有了他陪我，我们玩到很晚才回家。
sentences.traditional: 那天有了他陪我，我們玩到很晚才回家。
sentences.pinyin: nà tiān yǒu le tā péi wǒ wǒ men wán dào hěn wǎn cái huí jiā
sentences.english: That day he was there to accompany me. We didn’t get home until very late.

sentences.simplified: 我喝了太多酒，很快就睡着了。
sentences.traditional: 我喝了太多酒，很快就睡著了。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ hē le tài duō jiǔ hěn kuài jiù shuì zháo le
sentences.english: I had drunk too much alcohol and very quickly fell asleep.

sentences.simplified: 一点多的时候，我听到一些声音，然后看到他在我的房间里，好像在找什么东西。
sentences.traditional: 一點多的時候，我聽到一些聲音，然後看到他在我的房間裡，好像在找什麼東西。

sentences.english: Shortly after 1 o’clock, I heard some sounds. Then I saw him in my room as if he was looking for something.

sentences.simplified: 我马上明白了，他在找我的钱，他想拿了我的钱跑掉！
sentences.traditional: 我馬上明白了，他在找我的錢，他想拿了我的錢跑掉！
sentences.pinyin: wǒ mǎ shàng míng bai le tā zài zhǎo wǒ de qián tā xiǎng ná le wǒ de qián pǎo diào
sentences.english: I immediately understood. He was looking for my money. He wanted to take my money and make a run for it!

sentences.simplified: 我生气极了，大声说：‘我对你这么好，你还拿我的钱！’
sentences.traditional: 我生氣極了，大聲說：‘我對你這麼好，你還拿我的錢！’

sentences.english: I was incredibly angry and said loudly, ‘I treated you so well, yet you’re taking my money!’

sentences.simplified: 我拿起身边的椅子就去打他。

sentences.pinyin: wǒ ná qǐ shēn biān de yǐ zi jiù qù dǎ tā
sentences.english: I lifted up the chair beside me to beat him.

sentences.simplified: 我的力气很大，他很害怕，一边哭一边让我不要打。
sentences.traditional: 我的力氣很大，他很害怕，一邊哭一邊讓我不要打。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ de lì qi hěn dà tā hěn hài pà yì biān kū yì biān ràng wǒ bú yào dǎ
sentences.english: I was very strong. He was very afraid. He was crying and asking me not to beat him.

sentences.simplified: 我听不下去，力气越来越大。
sentences.traditional: 我聽不下去，力氣越來越大。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ tīng bú xià qù lì qi yuè lái yuè dà
sentences.english: I didn’t want to hear it, so I put more and more strength into it.

sentences.simplified: 打了很久，后来椅子打坏了，我扔了椅子，坐在地上，我还在生气。
sentences.traditional: 打了很久，後來椅子打壞了，我扔了椅子，坐在地上，我還在生氣。

sentences.english: I hit him for a long time. Afterward, the chair broke. I threw the chair away and sat on the ground. I was still angry.

sentences.simplified: 他躺在地上，没有说话，也不哭了。
sentences.traditional: 他躺在地上，沒有說話，也不哭了。
sentences.pinyin: tā tǎng zài dì shang méi yǒu shuō huà yě bù kū le
sentences.english: He was lying on the floor, not saying anything. He was also no longer crying.

sentences.simplified: 我失望极了，一点儿也不想看他。
sentences.traditional: 我失望極了，一點兒也不想看他。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ shī wàng jí le yì diǎn'r yě bù xiǎng kàn tā
sentences.english: I was very disappointed and didn’t want to look at him at all.

sentences.simplified: 我坐了半个小时，他还是一点儿声音也没有。
sentences.traditional: 我坐了半個小時，他還是一點兒聲音也沒有。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zuò le bàn ge xiǎo shí tā hái shi yì diǎn'r shēng yīn yě méi yǒu
sentences.english: I sat for half an hour, and he still didn’t make any sound.

sentences.simplified: 我觉得有些奇怪，就爬过去看他，发现他的身体很冷
sentences.traditional: 我覺得有些奇怪，就爬過去看他，發現他的身體很冷
sentences.pinyin: wǒ jué de yǒu xiē qí guài jiù pá guò qu kàn tā fā xiàn tā de shēn tǐ hěn lěng
sentences.english: I thought it was a little strange, so I crawled over to look at him. I discovered that his body was very cold.

sentences.simplified: 。我这才知道，他已经死了，他被我打死了。
sentences.traditional: 。我這才知道，他已經死了，他被我打死了。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zhè cái zhī dào tā yǐ jīng sǐ le tā bèi wǒ dǎ sǐ le
sentences.english: Only then did I know that he had died. He had been beaten to death by me.

sentences.simplified: 我害怕极了，不知道怎么办，不敢打电话给医院，也不敢打电话给警察局。
sentences.traditional: 我害怕極了，不知道怎麼辦，不敢打電話給醫院，也不敢打電話給警察局。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ hài pà jí le bù zhī dào zěn me bàn bù gǎn dǎ diàn huà gěi yī yuàn yě bù gǎn dǎ diàn huà gěi jǐng chá jú
sentences.english: I was so scared. I didn’t know what to do. I didn’t dare phone the hospital, nor did I dare phone the police station.

sentences.simplified: 我坐在他身边，哭了半个小时，后来我把他抱到了船上。
sentences.traditional: 我坐在他身邊，哭了半個小時，後來我把他抱到了船上。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zuò zài tā shēn biān kū le bàn ge xiǎo shí hòu lái wǒ bǎ tā bào dào le chuán shang
sentences.english: I sat beside him and cried for half an hour. Afterward, I carried him onto the boat.

sentences.simplified: 那时候是三点钟，大家都在睡觉，没有人发现我们。
sentences.traditional: 那時候是三點鐘，大家都在睡覺，沒有人發現我們。
sentences.pinyin: nà shí hou shì sān diǎn zhōng dà jiā dōu zài shuì jiào méi yǒu rén fā xiàn wǒ men
sentences.english: At that point in time, it was 3 o’clock. Everyone was still sleeping, so nobody discovered us.

sentences.simplified: 我开着船，往大海的远方去。三个小时后，天亮了，船离海边已经很远了，
sentences.traditional: 我開著船，往大海的遠方去。三個小時後，天亮了，船離海邊已經很遠了，
sentences.pinyin: wǒ kāi zhe chuán wǎng dà hǎi de yuǎn fāng qù sān ge xiǎo shí hòu tiān liàng le chuán lí hǎi biān yǐ jīng hěn yuǎn le
sentences.english: I set sail toward the distant ocean. Three hours later, the sun came up. The boat was already very far from the coast.

sentences.simplified: 我最后看了看他，然后把他推下了船，海水把他送到了远方。
sentences.traditional: 我最後看了看他，然後把他推下了船，海水把他送到了遠方。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zuì hòu kàn le kàn tā rán hòu bǎ tā tuī xià le chuán hǎi shuǐ bǎ tā sòng dào le yuǎn fāng
sentences.english: I looked at him for the last time then pushed him overboard. The ocean sent him off to a faraway place.

sentences.simplified: 回来后，我打扫了房间，和以前一样工作。
sentences.traditional: 回來後，我打掃了房間，和以前一樣工作。
sentences.pinyin: huí lái hòu wǒ dǎ sǎo le fáng jiān hé yǐ qián yí yàng gōng zuò
sentences.english: After I got back, I tidied up the room and kept working as before.

sentences.simplified: 没有人发现他不见了，只有大饭店的人问过一次，说和我一起工作的年轻人去哪儿了，
sentences.traditional: 沒有人發現他不見了，只有大飯店的人問過一次，說和我一起工作的年輕人去哪兒了，
sentences.pinyin: méi yǒu rén fā xiàn tā bú jiàn le zhǐ yǒu dà fàn diàn de rén wèn guò yí cì shuō hé wǒ yì qǐ gōng zuò de nián qīng rén qù nǎ'r le
sentences.english: Nobody realized that he had disappeared. Some people at the restaurant asked once where the young person who worked with me had gone.

sentences.simplified: 我回答说他回家了，后来就没有人问了。
sentences.traditional: 我回答說他回家了，後來就沒有人問了。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ huí dá shuō tā huí jiā le hòu lái jiù méi yǒu rén wèn le
sentences.english: I answered that he had gone home. After that, nobody else asked.

sentences.simplified: 他本来就没有朋友，也从来不和家人联系，他就像个没家的人，死了也没人知道。
sentences.traditional: 他本來就沒有朋友，也從來不和家人聯繫，他就像個沒家的人，死了也沒人知道。
sentences.pinyin: tā běn lái jiù méi yǒu péng you yě cóng lái bù hé jiā rén lián xì tā jiù xiàng ge méi jiā de rén sǐ le yě méi rén zhī dào
sentences.english: He didn’t have any friends to start with and never contacted his family. He was like a homeless person. Nobody even knew that he had died.

sentences.simplified: 第二年，我不出海打鱼了，还把海边的房子卖了。
sentences.traditional: 第二年，我不出海打魚了，還把海邊的房子賣了。

sentences.english: The next year, I no longer went out to the sea to fish. I even sold my house by the sea.

sentences.simplified: 我在公园旁边买了一个新房子，换了一种新生活。
sentences.traditional: 我在公園旁邊買了一個新房子，換了一種新生活。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zài gōng yuán páng biān mǎi le yí ge xīn fáng zi huàn le yì zhǒng xīn shēng huó
sentences.english: I bought a new house next to a park and started a new life.

sentences.simplified: 这件事情已经过去十五年了，我从来没有和人说过，
sentences.traditional: 這件事情已經過去十五年了，我從來沒有和人說過，
sentences.pinyin: zhè jiàn shì qing yǐ jīng guò qù shí wǔ nián le wǒ cóng lái méi yǒu hé rén shuō guò
sentences.english: It’s already been 15 years since this incident. I’ve never told anyone.

sentences.simplified: 现在说给你们听，是因为我快死了，我已经不害怕了。”
sentences.traditional: 現在說給你們聽，是因為我快死了，我已經不害怕了。”
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài shuō gěi nǐ men tīng shì yīn wèi wǒ kuài sǐ le wǒ yǐ jīng bú hài pà le
sentences.english: I am telling you now because I’m going to die soon. I am no longer afraid.”

sentence_translations: Chapter 37: A Boy (2)
The man smiled and continued speaking: “When he heard me say that I would kill him, he became afraid and said he wouldn’t leave.
I was very happy. He finally listened.
One month later, it was my birthday one day. I took him out to a big restaurant for dinner.
We drank a lot of alcohol. He even had birthday cake with me.
That night I was very happy. Previously I had always spent my birthday alone.
That day he was there to accompany me. We didn’t get home until very late.
I had drunk too much alcohol and very quickly fell asleep.
Shortly after 1 o’clock, I heard some sounds. Then I saw him in my room as if he was looking for something.
I immediately awoke and loudly asked him, ‘What are you looking for?’
He didn’t reply. I turned on the lights and saw that he was holding a lot of money in his hands.
I immediately understood. He was looking for my money. He wanted to take my money and make a run for it!
I was incredibly angry and said loudly, ‘I treated you so well, yet you’re taking my money!’
I lifted up the chair beside me to beat him.
I was very strong. He was very afraid. He was crying and asking me not to beat him.
I didn’t want to hear it, so I put more and more strength into it.
I hit him for a long time. Afterward, the chair broke. I threw the chair away and sat on the ground. I was still angry.
He was lying on the floor, not saying anything. He was also no longer crying.
I was very disappointed and didn’t want to look at him at all.
I sat for half an hour, and he still didn’t make any sound.
I thought it was a little strange, so I crawled over to look at him. I discovered that his body was very cold.
Only then did I know that he had died. He had been beaten to death by me.
I was so scared. I didn’t know what to do. I didn’t dare phone the hospital, nor did I dare phone the police station.
I sat beside him and cried for half an hour. Afterward, I carried him onto the boat.
At that point in time, it was 3 o’clock. Everyone was still sleeping, so nobody discovered us.
I set sail toward the distant ocean. Three hours later, the sun came up. The boat was already very far from the coast.
I looked at him for the last time then pushed him overboard. The ocean sent him off to a faraway place.
After I got back, I tidied up the room and kept working as before.
Nobody realized that he had disappeared. Some people at the restaurant asked once where the young person who worked with me had gone.
I answered that he had gone home. After that, nobody else asked.
He didn’t have any friends to start with and never contacted his family. He was like a homeless person. Nobody even knew that he had died.
The next year, I no longer went out to the sea to fish. I even sold my house by the sea.
I bought a new house next to a park and started a new life.
It’s already been 15 years since this incident. I’ve never told anyone.
I am telling you now because I’m going to die soon. I am no longer afraid.”
